{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check column names
print("Column names:", trial_df.columns.tolist())

# Check the unique values in the 'arm' column
unique_arms = trial_df['arm'].unique()
print("Unique arms:", unique_arms)

# Check the distribution of arms
arm_counts = trial_df['arm'].value_counts()
print("Arm counts:\n", arm_counts)

# Check the response-related columns
response_cols = [col for col in trial_df.columns if 'response' in col.lower() or 'resp' in col.lower()]
print("Potential response columns:", response_cols)

# Check the first few rows of the data
print(trial_df.head())"}
